heading: Alexios, Dash and Vortex catch the eye
author: Racing Correspondent
paragraphs: Alexios, Dash and Vortex caught the eye when the horses were exercised here on Sunday (Sept. 20) morning.

800m: Thundering Phoenix (Santosh) 54, 600/40. Moved freely. Bravion (Ajinkya) 52, 600/39. Moved freely. Golden Hues (Yash) 55, 600/42. Easy. Shadow Phoenix (Ajinkya) 53, 600/38. Moved well. Immortal Star (S.J. Sunil), Abhyankar (Vishal) 53, 600/39. Former finished a distance ahead. Absolute Honour (app), Sukoon (Kaviraj) 56, 600/41. Pair moved together freely.
1200m: Shaandaar (Vivek), Manuel (A. Prakash) 1-23, 1000/1-8, 800/53, 600/40. They moved neck and neck freely. Alexios (Gore) 1-21, 1000/1-6, 800/51, 600/38. Moved nicely.

1400m: Dash (Aditya), Vortex (Yash) 1-35, 1200/1-20, 1000/1-5, 800/52, 600/39. Both moved impressively. Namiri (Kirtish), Mahogany (Vivek) 1-38, 1200/1-23, 1000/1-7, 800/52, 600/39. They moved level freely.
